rule_implemented: docs/TERMS.md. Day 1 = the day after notification (art. 155 c.1 c.p.c.). Optional feriale suspension 1-31 August (L. 742/1969 art. 1, as amended by D.L. 132/2014). Expiry on Sunday/public holiday -> next working day (art. 155 c.4 c.p.c.; art. 2963 c.c.); Saturday -> Monday only where saturday_rollover (art. 155 c.5 c.p.c.). PEC delivered at/after 21:00 Europe/Rome -> notification perfected for the recipient the next day, only where pec_after_21_rule (art. 147 c.p.c. as amended by D.Lgs. 149/2022).
